card.name: Units and digits right before a hyphen or slash
card.fires_on: A digit or unit letter (2, 3, 1, g, mg, mcg) that sits just before a hyphen or slash, as in 'Beta 2-adrenergic', 'g/kg/day' or '250 mg/kg'. It marks a spot where a dash or slash comes next.

modes.label: Unit before slash
modes.description: The g or mg of a rate or dose unit, right before '/kg'.

modes.label: Number before hyphen in a name
modes.description: A locant number in a chemical or drug class name, right before a hyphen.

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of hyphenated name continuations such as '-An' or '-Cal' and to raise odds of single capital letters, so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires on a number or unit letter that is about to be followed by a dash or slash, like 2-adrenergic or g/kg.
